The body explains why placement is not assertable layout-free. That is a fair limit for the grader's literal substring match.
- **Scope and shape.** The SKILL.md paragraph, the eval file and the root changeset are inside claim 6963949473's surface. The three cuts outside the paragraph are same-file payment, as the order allows, and each is listed. `Fixes #34785`, Clause-② `no` and Metadata-protocol `none` match the claim. The changeset names `@objectstack/skills` (patch).

- N2 (nit, reflow): the index pointer's middle line is now 125 characters ("(on a declared index bare `unique: true` is refused), the retired …").
- N3: `evals/README.md`'s one-line coverage list for this fixture does not mention the new extension-translation case. It is incomplete rather than false, and outside the claimed surface.
- N4: CI at this head when I read it: 14 success, 16 skipped, 11 in progress (Test Core shards, Live E2E UI, the Type Check jobs, ESLint, and the repo/tooling, CI/release/engine and docs/code Lint gates), 0 failed. Landing waits for all of them to finish green, including the skills token ratchet and the two families left to CI (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`).
- N5: #35022 and #33849 touch the same files. Whichever lands later re-reads the ratchet on its final head, because this file is at headroom 0.

This record does not vouch for them.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` — the added sentence, clause by clause against the code at this head.**

- *"in the patching package's `translations`"* — true. `getPackageTranslationBundle` reads `registry.getPackage(packageId).manifest.translations`, then that package's active `translation` rows over them (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts:1019-1052`). `patchTranslationBundlesOf` asks it once per package that patches the object (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:3466-3497`), and both `/meta` exits pass the result as `patchBundles` (`:3629-3635`, `:3707-3712`).
- *"under the owner's keys (`objects.crm_account.fields.industry.label`, `.help`, `.options.VALUE`)"* — true. `translateObject` reads the patch catalog with the same lookups the owner's text uses: `lookupObjectFieldAttr(…, 'label')` and `(…, 'help')` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:5272-5292`, lookup at `:4272-4286`) and `lookupObjectFieldOption` (`:5322-5330`, lookup at `:4679-4697`). `FieldTranslationSchema` declares exactly `label`, `help`, `options` as a value-to-string map (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:229-232`). The skill does not claim `placeholder`, which the patch whitelist allows but `translateObject` never translates: the omission is correct.
- *"the owner's translation of the replaced text never applies"* — true. `partCatalog` (`i18n-resolver.ts:5254-5266`) returns the deployment catalog only for a slot whose value still equals the packaged base; a changed slot reads the first patch catalog whose `patchedBase` wrote that value, else the pair's alone. It also holds when the patching package ships no translation at all (no `patchBundles` entry, the slot falls to `catalogs.changed`).
- *"a pair `.custom` translation comes first on `/meta`"* — true, and correctly scoped. `patchCatalogsOf` lays the pair bundle over each package's (`i18n-resolver.ts:570-581`, rank documented at `:512-516`); the public form passes `patchBundles` and no `pairBundle` (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts:389-394`), so the pair rank exists on the `/meta` reads only.
- *"an untranslated locale serves the patch text"* — true: no catalog hit leaves `next.label` and the option untouched (`i18n-resolver.ts:5276`, `:5330`).
- **Agreement with other teaching.** Matches `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx:132-139` clause for clause. No contradiction in `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (it teaches `defineStack({ translations: [...] })` at `:449` and option keys as value-keyed strings at `:217`, `:505`) or `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`. `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` skips an `objectExtensions[]` target the stack does not define wholly (rung 2b, `:202`), so the taught keys draw no `translation-target-unknown`. `ObjectTranslationDataSchema.label` is optional (`translation.zod.ts:550`), so a bundle carrying only `fields` under `crm_account` parses.

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` — case 21.**

- `expected_output` is true against the code: the bundle shape `'zh-CN': { objects: { crm_account: { fields: { industry: { label }, type: { options: { customer: STRING } } } } } }` is what the lookups and `FieldTranslationSchema` read; help under the field's `help`; pair first on `/meta`; untranslated locale serves `Sector`.
- Every `must_contain` token is a literal substring of `expected_output`, the `must_not_contain` token is not, ids are distinct (read off the fixture at this head). All six tokens are single words with no whitespace, quote or line break, so `gradeAnswer`'s `answer.includes(t)` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts:28-29`, case-sensitive, nothing normalised) can match them whatever the answer's layout.

Findings:

- S1 (should-fix) — case 21 forbids the bare word `overrides`. The grader matches a literal substring, and `overrides` is an ordinary English verb that a correct answer reaches for when it paraphrases the very clauses the case tests: "the `hotcrm.custom` translation overrides yours on `/meta`", "your zh-CN label overrides HotCRM's", or the skill's own next paragraph, "it takes no `overrides` declaration" (SKILL.md:385). Each of those is a right answer that this assertion fails. The file's own precedent forbids the code spelling, `overrides:` (cases 5 and 7), which a prose sentence does not hit and which is as layout-stable as `namespace:` or `partial:` in cases 1 and 3. Fix: spell it `overrides:` as cases 5 and 7 do, or drop the forbidden token. The head moves, so the fix earns a delta review.
- N1 (nit) — five of the six `must_contain` tokens (`acme_billing`, `zh-CN`, `crm_account`, `industry`, `customer`) are already in the prompt; only `translations` is new, so an answer that puts the strings in HotCRM's files also passes. The PR body states this limit. A layout-free token the prompt lacks, `objects` (the key root of the taught address), would tighten it a little; could ride S1's fix or be left as an accepted deviation.
- N2 (nit) — "an untranslated locale serves the patch text" is exact when no locale of the request's fallback chain has an entry; `lookupObjectFieldAttr` walks `localeChain(opts)`, so a fallback locale the package does translate is served first. The docs page words it the same way.
- N3 (nit) — `.help` is served on the field's `inlineHelpText` when it authors one, on `description` only when it authors none (`i18n-resolver.ts:5283-5293`); the skill's bare `.help` leaves that to the docs page. Consistent with the one-sentence budget at headroom 0.
- N4 (nit) — the index pointer's middle line is now about 125 characters (SKILL.md:352), unwrapped against the file's hand-wrapped prose.

No must-fix. S1 is open on this head.
